versions.content: References from DiagnosticSecureCodingMapping to DiagnosticRoutine The DiagnosticRoutine referenced by meta-class Diag- nosticSecureCodingMapping in the role validation is responsible for finalizing the coding procedure. The finalization consists mainly of the verification of the procedure and the persistent storage of the coding information after a successful verification.
